verdict.rationale: LangGraph integrates with LangSmith to provide tracing/visualization of agent execution paths, state transitions, and runtime metrics, and docs explicitly point developers to LangSmith tracing quickstart to see how data flows through each step of workflows/agents. This is first-party documented and referenced across GitHub and docs sources, though the observability UI itself (LangSmith) is a separate product rather than built into LangGraph proper. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of using the tracing UI, and more detail on tool-call-level granularity within the UI.
